[cg_accordion title='Core Features']\
    \
  • \Material:\ Printed on premium 260gsm white high-gloss folding greeting card for a bright, vibrant and professional finish.\
    • \
  • \Card Size:\ Each card measures approximately 148mm x 148mm (6 x 6 inches) when folded.\
    • \
  • \Envelope Included:\ Supplied with a 155mm x 155mm recycled kraft fleck envelope.\
    • \
  • \Personalisation:\ Personalisation options vary by design and may include the recipient's name, age, recipient title, year and other design-specific details.\
    • \
  • \Photo Designs:\ Where a photograph is supplied, the finished artwork will usually be designed to resemble the person or image provided while matching the style of the chosen card.\
    • \
  • \Design Proof:\ A proof can be supplied before production so you can check that you are happy with the finished design. Production will begin once the proof has been approved. If you are happy for us to proceed without approval, you can choose to waive the proof-checking stage when ordering.\
    • \
  • \Additional Design Requests:\ Specific additional design features or changes can be requested for an additional 50p. Please provide the details required when ordering.\
    • \
[/cg_accordion][cg_accordion title='Details']Our personalised greeting cards are created to make each occasion that little bit more special. Each design is printed on premium 260gsm high-gloss white card and supplied with a recycled kraft fleck envelope. Depending on the chosen design, you can personalise details such as the recipient's name, age, title, year and other relevant wording. For photo-based designs, we use your supplied image as a reference while retaining the overall artwork style shown in the product images. A design proof can be provided before production, giving you the opportunity to check the artwork and request any necessary corrections before the card is printed. If you do not require a proof, you can choose for us to proceed directly to production. If you would like a particular additional feature, detail or alteration that is not included as part of the standard design, this can usually be added for an additional 50p.[/cg_accordion][cg_accordion title='Delivery & Returns']\
    \
  • \Production Time:\ Please allow approximately 1-3 working days for your card to be created and prepared for dispatch. Where a proof is requested, this timescale begins once the proof has been approved.\
    • \
  • \Proof Approval:\ If a design proof is requested, please check all names, ages, wording, dates and design details carefully before approving it. Once approval has been given and production has started, changes may no longer be possible.\
    • \
  • \Priority Production:\ If you need your card produced more quickly, priority production can be requested for an additional 50p. Please select this option when ordering where available.\
    • \
  • \Shipping:\ Once completed, your card will be dispatched using the delivery service selected at checkout.\
    • \
  • \Returns:\ Personalised or made-to-order cards cannot normally be returned for a change of mind. Non-personalised items may be returned in accordance with our standard returns policy. If your order arrives damaged, faulty or incorrect, please contact us and we will arrange an appropriate replacement or resolution.\
    • \
[/cg_accordion]
